label: POST HOC: read after every run's data was committed; no rule, threshold or verdict of any run changes

A_catalogue.what: E46's catalogue (26 Sep, three passes on each of three cards): board W over idle less the three rails less the published delivery-loss fit (unmetered_fit.json coefficients), per configuration and per burst

offrail_vs_minion_instructions.what: over idle: off-rail watts (board less the three rails) = a m + b m^2, m the minion rail over idle
over idle: off-rail watts (board less the three rails) = a m + b m^2, m the minion rail over idle
over idle: off-rail watts (board less the three rails) = a m + b m^2, m the minion rail over idle

B_tensorfma.what: per run: the board less (1 + coefficient) x each rail, on the zeros footing (D, kind minus its type's zeros at the same time, raw on every meter) and over the idle bracket (S, raw); rails deconvolved with E58's per-rail filter (and E78's registered one as an arm)

C_card1_vs_a3.what: pool 8's shared tiles, E171 (aifoundry3) against E172 (card 1), items with D >= 2 W on both: card 1 / aifoundry3 on each meter, raw and after each card's own V squared (the on-die minion reading in the power window)

minion_share_ratio_c1_over_a3_reductions.what: the same ratio on the two reductions' own D and Drail (E78's filter, leak-corrected)

thermal_reading.note: h1 = h3 is an assumption the data cannot check (each card's TIM, heatsink and PVT calibration differ)

D_thermal.what: E181's five 600 s holds (aifoundry3, one session): each hold's watts above the last 120 s of the rest before it on every meter, against the chain's rise P and the 34-sensor mean's measured rise R (scored-m11.json); post hoc

board_gain_reading.what: the one gain on the board's watts that best explains e (e = -g P): the meter would read (1 + g) of what the chain was calibrated on

onrail_reading.what: first order: the chain's rise scaled by each hold's on-rail share of its board watts over H_E's (heat taken to follow the three rails, not the board); approximate, history ignored

dips_dropped_reading.what: first order: the chain's rise scaled by each hold's board watts with the dips removed over its watts as the chain read them (the chain's input keeps every sample)

E_limits.what: the meters' own limits on committed data: E171's, E172's and E178's kept passes, E181's measured pass (dips kept in these counts: each telemetry file as committed)

H_heat_sessions.what: heat per watt over the power window, session by session (each primary reduction's runs.csv; post hoc)

F_int8_pair.what: E178-H-int8, int8 5s - 4s, in the scorer's form (per pass the mean over segments of D(5s) - D(4s); over the four kept passes the mean and t(0.975, 3) interval), read on every meter; post hoc
